## Validation and limitations

The strategy retrieved **14/14 known development records (100% relative recall)**. These records were identified during the build, so this is not independent validation or diagnostic sensitivity; no separate validation set or same-scope review benchmark was available. The required cutoff is by PubMed Entrez entry date through 2013-06-09; no publication-date limit was applied.

The search is recall-first and may retrieve falciparum-only, non-endemic, asymptomatic, or otherwise ineligible studies. The `OptiMAL[tiab]` term is especially broad and may add noise. The internal PRESS-structured critique passed, but **human PRESS peer review by an information specialist is still needed before use**.
